faqs.a:
Any person filing with the council a complaint, protest or objection on any one or
               more specific grounds in writing, as provided in this article, shall have the right
               within 15 days after the council has finally passed on such complaint, protest or
               objection by resolution, as provided in
section 78-33
, or by ordinance, as provided in
section 78-42
hereof, to commence an action or suit in any court of competent jurisdiction to correct
               or to set aside only such a determination of the council on any such specific and
               written complaint, protest or objection; and thereafter all actions or suits attacking
               the validity of the preliminary plans, any preliminary estimate of cost, assessment
               plat, other proceedings and any maximum amount of benefits shall be perpetually barred.
(Code 1981, § 27-38; Ord. No. 551, § 15, 5-14-1964)
